source.source_locator: 教則 第3章 3.1.2(2)2)b「目視による常時監視」

evidence.answer_defining_proposition: 安全な飛行のためバッテリー残量等を確認する目的で一時的に機体から目を離してモニターを確認する行為は目視飛行の範囲内である。
evidence.tested_misconception: 飛行中に一瞬でもモニターを見ると必ず目視外飛行になる。
evidence.reasoning_path: direct visual monitoring -> brief safety-information check -> temporary interruption remains within VLOS

collision.note: Tier B。Q048は継続的なモニター監視・補助者監視を目視外と判定する。本問は教則が明示する一時的な安全確認の例外境界を問う。

independent_review.rationale: The source explicitly states that briefly looking away from the aircraft to check battery level or similar safety information remains within visual-line-of-sight flight. Q048 tests sustained monitor/assistant observation as BVLOS, so this is a source-defined exception boundary rather than a wording variant.

director_adjudication.rationale: Adopt all nine independent-review ACCEPT decisions because each candidate has direct current MLIT 教則第5版 support and survived the full-336 canonical collision gate. C004 and C005 test different conjunctive indirect-participant requirements than Q002; together with Q002 they reach the default same-core density ceiling of three, so no additional variant on that core is approved without explicit override. C006 tests the Remote ID tether-exemption branch, distinct from Q030's flight-method tether exception and Q047's Remote ID special-area exemption. C007 tests the actual Remote ID broadcast payload and the exclusion of owner/user information, which is not answer-defining elsewhere in the canonical bank. C008 tests the priority of emergency-use airspace designation over ordinary airport/150m/DID permissions, distinct from Q041's sub-100g applicability rule. C009 tests straight-line measurement geometry for the 30m rule, distinct from Q104's property classification. No HUMAN review is claimed.
